CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p1/current/n1), organization/presentation (coordinate mapping and layout), and provenance/status (origin) are all explicitly recorded for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple literal entries identify represented content (color-labeled coordinate sets).

D.rationale: Origin/provenance fields separately record status/identity information distinct from the content coordinate listings.

O.rationale: Coordinate listings and the explicit layout note state how content is presented/organized.
